lines.text: Wake up, pilot. That bump you heard was a micrometeorite taking a bite out of the ship.
I am Laila. I run the navigation core, and right now I am the only thing out here keeping you pointed home.
Three critical parts are scattered across the solar system. Bring them back and I can put this ship together again.
First, learn the suit. Use W A S D or the arrow keys. Your jetpack has drift, so brake early.
Good. The beacon is still alive, which means the solar map is too. One more thing before we leave orbit.
That crate holds the navigation module's mounting bracket. Grab it, then we can launch.
If you ever feel lost out there, press H. I will always answer.
Map is online. Mars, Mercury and Venus are marked - every one of them is holding a piece of this ship.
Choose any of the three. I will be in your ear the whole way.
The beacon is up and to the right. Hold the direction, then ease off to stop.
The crate is below and left of the ship. Press E when you are touching it.
No rush, pilot. The solar system is not going anywhere. Unfortunately.
Try the arrow keys if WASD feels awkward. Both work.
